summary: The diff implements REQ-12 comprehensively: a reusable ImageWithDisclaimer component is created with the exact disclaimer text, a dark semi-transparent overlay anchored to the bottom, white text, and overflow containment. The component is applied across all specified pages (HomePage, SafeLearningPage, EcoSevaPage, EmpowermentPage, AboutPage) and additional pages (AashaCoinsPage, DonateGoodsPage, DonateMoneyPage, VisualNotebookPage, GuardianGamePage, LearningDashboard). The implementation appears complete with no missing requirements identified and no hallucinated features beyond what was requested.
